title: Managing Optional Extensions in Business Central AL Code
summary: This post explains how to create a single Business Central extension that optionally interacts with a third-party extension without creating a hard dependency. The technique uses NavApp.GetModuleInfo to detect if an optional extension is installed, then uses RecordRef and FieldRef to conditionally set extension-specific fields.
key_points: Use NavApp.GetModuleInfo with an extension GUID to detect if an optional extension is installed at runtime
Create separate logical steps for core functionality and optional extension-specific field updates
Use RecordRef and FieldRef with field IDs to access and modify extension fields without adding a dependency
Check if a FieldRef is active before setting its value to ensure the field exists
This approach allows a single extension to work in systems with or without the optional third-party extension
